title: Do Candlestick Charts Suffice? The Incremental Economic Value of Technical Indicators in Stock Return Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.30584v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although technical analysis remains widely used in practice, the need for manually constructed indicators is increasingly questioned as deep learning models can extract features directly from OHLC price data. This paper examines the standalone economic value of trading volume and manually constructed technical-indicator groups and whether adding these groups to OHLC candlestick charts provides incremental economic value. Using daily data for 1,707 Chinese A-share stocks from 2013 to 2025, we construct approximately 3.36 million stock-window samples and encode them as multi-channel images containing candlestick charts, trading volume, and seven widely used manually constructed technical indicators. The primary analysis uses a 2D CNN on these images; complementary tests apply a logistic regression, a 1D CNN, and an LSTM to numerical representations of the same samples. Out-of-sample performance from 2021 to 2025 is evaluated using decile

translated_title: K线图就够了吗？技术指标在股票收益预测中的增量经济价值
translated_abstract: 尽管技术分析在实践中仍被广泛使用，但由于深度学习模型可以直接从OHLC价格数据中提取特征，手工构建指标的必要性正受到越来越多的质疑。本文考察了交易量以及手工构建的技术指标组群的独立经济价值，以及将这些组群添加到OHLC K线图中是否能提供增量经济价值。利用2013年至2025年1707只中国A股股票的日度数据，我们构建了约336万个股票窗口样本，并将其编码为包含K线图、交易量和七种广泛使用的手工构建技术指标的多通道图像。主要分析在这些图像上使用二维卷积神经网络（2D CNN）；补充测试则将逻辑回归、一维CNN和LSTM应用于相同样本的数值表示。2021年至2025年的样本外表现通过十分位（decile）方法进行评估……
tldr: 本文基于1707只中国A股2013-2025年约336万个股票窗口样本，将K线图、交易量及七种手工构建技术指标编码为多通道图像并使用2D CNN等深度学习模型，实证检验交易量和技术指标是否在OHLC K线图之外为股票收益预测提供增量经济价值。
